([[Baton Rouge, Louisiana]]) | college = [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] (2013–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *2× First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2015, 2016) }} '''Damian William Jones''' (born June 30, 1995) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]]. Jones attended [[Scotlandville Magnet High School]] in [[Baton Rouge, Louisiana]].[http://www.nola.com/recruiting/index.ssf/2013/04/scotlandvilles_damian_jones_an.html Scotlandville's Damian Jones and Brian Bridgewater look forward to facing off in SEC] He was rated by [[Rivals.com]] as a four-star recruit and committed to [[Vanderbilt University]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://sports.yahoo.com/usf/basketball/recruiting/player-Damian-Jones-139989 Rivals.com][http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2012/09/02/four-star-forward-damian-jones-commits-to-vanderbilt/ Four-star forward Damian Jones commits to Vanderbilt] As a freshman, Jones appeared in all 31 games and started 28. He averaged 11.3 points, 5.7 rebounds and 1.4 blocks per game.[http://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2014/02/28/wanted-by-top-programs-vanderbilts-damian-jones-having-big-freshman-season/5915639/ Wanted by top programs, Vanderbilt’s Damian Jones having big freshman season] As a sophomore he played in 35 games with 34 starts and averaged 14.5 points, 6.5 rebounds and 2.0 blocks. Entering his junior year he announced that it would be his final season and that he would be entering the [[2016 NBA Draft]].[http://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2015/10/21/vanderbilt-damian-jones-enter-nba-draft-2016/74103188/ Vanderbilt's Damian Jones to enter NBA Draft in 2016] Jones is currently projected to be a mid-to-late first round draft pick. However, Jones recently went under surgery for repairing a torn pectoral muscle that was caused during one of his weightlifting practices.http://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources--vanderbilt-s-damian-jones-undergoes-surgery-for-pectoral-injury-183322852.html?soc_src=mail&soc_trk=ma Jones is, however, expected to be back on the court in time for the regular season to begin, with his stock likely to not be affected in the process. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.vucommodores.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/damian_jones_849751.html Vanderbilt Commodores bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Jones, Damian}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Louisiana]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Baton Rouge, Louisiana]] [[Category:Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball players]]
